title: Imports
description: Upload, check and create links in a few steps.
limits: Up to 10 MiB and 50,000 rows. UTF-8 CSV with a header row.
uploadHelp: Your file uploads privately. Review column mapping and run a dry run before anything is created.
cancelHelp: Cancellation keeps rows already created and stops the remaining work.
background: You can leave this page. Find this job in Import history.
mappingHelp: Choose the destination column. Optional fields can be ignored. Assign each source column only once. Tags use commas or semicolons. Expiry uses an ISO date and time.
dryRunHelp: Nothing has been created. Creating imports all valid rows and skips invalid rows. Capacity is checked again before creation.
createLinks: Create all {count, plural, one {# valid link} other {# valid links}}
createQr: Create all {count, plural, one {# valid QR code} other {# valid QR codes}}
previewHelp: Preview cells show up to 200 characters. The dry run validates complete values and reports row errors below.
previewTable: Source preview, scroll to see all columns
tagHelp: Up to 50 matching tags. Type to find more; apply to filter rows.
rowCount: {count, plural, one {# matching row} other {# matching rows}}
disabled: Imports are currently unavailable. Return to your library or try again later.
notFound: This import is unavailable or has expired. Start a new import or return to your library.

errors.failed: The operation could not finish. Try again or start a new import.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this operation. Check workspace and custom domain access.
errors.invalid_input: Check your input and try again.
errors.empty_file: Choose a non-empty CSV file or paste at least one URL.
errors.file_too_large: The file exceeds 10 MiB. Split it into smaller files.
errors.too_many_rows: There are more than 50,000 rows. Split the import into smaller files.
errors.field_too_large: A CSV value exceeds 8,192 characters. Shorten it and upload again.
errors.invalid_csv: The CSV format is invalid. Check quotes, headers and column counts, then upload again.
errors.invalid_encoding: Save the CSV as UTF-8 and upload it again.
errors.invalid_mapping: Choose a destination column and assign each column only once.
errors.invalid_state: The import changed. Refresh the page to see its current state.
errors.empty_import: There are no valid rows to create. Correct the file or mapping and validate again.
errors.not_found: The import is unavailable or has expired.
errors.unavailable: Imports are unavailable. Try again later.
errors.storage_unavailable: Private storage is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.upload_failed: The upload failed. Check your connection and upload the file again.
errors.upload_cancelled: Upload cancelled. You can choose a file and start again.
errors.limit_exceeded: The workspace has insufficient capacity. Change your plan or free capacity, then try again.
errors.commit_limit_exceeded: The workspace has insufficient capacity. Change your plan or free capacity, then try again.
errors.limit_reached: The workspace has insufficient capacity. Change your plan or free capacity, then try again.
errors.feature_required: This row uses a feature that requires a different plan. Remove the optional field or change your plan.
errors.access_removed: The importer no longer has access. Ask a workspace admin to review permissions and start a new import.
errors.upload_missing_or_changed: The uploaded file is missing or its size changed. Start a new import with the complete file.
errors.source_changed: The uploaded file changed during inspection. Start a new import.
errors.infrastructure_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Pending jobs retry automatically; refresh later.
errors.reservation_closed: The reserved capacity is no longer available. Start a new import.
errors.snapshot_missing: The source rows are unavailable. Start a new import.
